<?php
// Lire tout
$content = file_get_contents('data.txt');

// Ecrire (ecrase)
file_put_contents('data.txt', "Bonjour\n");

// Append
file_put_contents('log.txt', date('c')."\n", FILE_APPEND);

<?php
// Lire ligne par ligne
$f = fopen('big.log', 'r');
while (($line = fgets($f)) !== false) {
    echo $line;
}
fclose($f);

// Ecrire
$f = fopen('out.txt', 'w');
fwrite($f, "Ligne 1\n");
fclose($f);

<?php
// Lire
$f = fopen('data.csv', 'r');
while (($row = fgetcsv($f)) !== false) {
    print_r($row);
}
fclose($f);

// Ecrire
$f = fopen('data.csv', 'a');
fputcsv($f, ['Chadi', 'chadi@s.lb', date('Y-m-d')]);
fclose($f);
